properties.name: picsure.ai.max-tool-iterations
properties.description: Hard cap on tool-call round-trips per chat turn. Hitting it returns the best answer so far, prose only, never an error. Maps from the AI_MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS environment variable.

properties.name: picsure.ai.max-filters
properties.description: Most filters (subqueries count too) a query may hold and still be read or proposed by the model. Over it, the researcher's query is withheld from the model and the model's own proposals are refused. The researcher has no such limit in the UI; this only bounds what is resent to the model on every call. Must be at least 1. Maps from the AI_MAX_FILTERS environment variable.

properties.name: picsure.ai.model.http.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the HTTP Converse endpoint ConverseHttpModelClient posts to ({base}/model/{modelId}/converse). Required when picsure.ai.model.provider=http; startup fails when blank.

properties.name: picsure.ai.model.http.api-token
properties.description: Bearer token ConverseHttpModelClient sends in the Authorization header. Required when picsure.ai.model.provider=http; startup fails when blank.

properties.name: picsure.ai.model.http.model-id
properties.description: Model id ConverseHttpModelClient puts in the request path. Required when picsure.ai.model.provider=http; startup fails when blank.

properties.name: picsure.ai.mcp.gateway-url
properties.description: Base URL of the gateway whose /mcp route GatewayMcpToolGateway connects to. Required when picsure.ai.mcp.mode=gateway (the default). Maps from the PICSURE_GATEWAY_URL environment variable.

properties.name: picsure.ai.mcp.service-token
properties.description: Shared secret GatewayMcpToolGateway sends as X-PIC-SURE-AI-TOKEN on every /mcp call, so the gateway admits the call by ASSISTED_SEARCH and pic-sure-mcp does not require PIC_SURE_MCP. Required when picsure.ai.mcp.mode=gateway (the default); must equal the gateway's AI_SERVICE_TOKEN. Maps from the AI_SERVICE_TOKEN environment variable.

properties.name: picsure.ai.mcp.excluded-tools
properties.description: Comma-separated gateway tool names withheld from the model and refused if it requests them anyway. Set blank to offer every tool. Maps from the AI_MCP_EXCLUDED_TOOLS environment variable.

properties.name: picsure.ai.mcp.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long GatewayMcpToolGateway waits to open a connection to the gateway's /mcp route.

properties.name: picsure.ai.mcp.read-timeout
properties.description: How long GatewayMcpToolGateway waits for a response from the gateway's /mcp route.

properties.name: picsure.ai.conversation.store
properties.description: Where conversations and turn results are kept. memory, the only implementation, keeps them in this instance's memory: lost on restart and not shared between instances. Maps from the AI_CONVERSATION_STORE environment variable.

properties.name: picsure.ai.conversation.idle-timeout
properties.description: How long a conversation is kept after its last use.

properties.name: picsure.ai.conversation.max-turns
properties.description: Turns kept per conversation; the oldest are dropped first.

properties.name: picsure.ai.conversation.max-total-chars
properties.description: Bound on what all conversations hold together, in characters; the least recently used are dropped first.

properties.name: picsure.ai.conversation.result-ttl
properties.description: How long a turn's response stays retrievable by requestId, for retries and GET /chat/{requestId}. Keep it at least idle-timeout.

properties.name: picsure.ai.conversation.max-results-per-owner
properties.description: Most turn results kept for one caller; the oldest go first. Never evicts another caller's results.
